ai.title: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW
ai.brief: Good games bring people together. This GFN Thursday, GeForce NOW is celebrating the members, creators and community moderators who turn every session into something worth sharing. From friendships formed in online lobbies to new worlds explored on everyday devices, GeForce NOW Ambassadors share their reasons to love cloud gaming. Those ready to find their own can get 30% off six-month Performance and Ultimate memberships in the Black Friday sale and a special seasonal offer through Amazon Fire TV Sticks. Plus, War Thunder gets a new look with NVIDIA DLSS 5 for Ultimate members and a Ready for Battle Pack reward is now available across all membership tiers. Rounding out the week, 12 new games join the GeForce NOW library . Behind every screenshot, helpful tip and play session is a gamer with a story. GeForce NOW Ambassadors share what keeps them playing.

sec.title: Drupal Warns of New Critical Flaw Exploited in the Wild
sec.brief: S. S. 0 Exposed: Massive Botnet Hides Ad Fraud Inside Android TV Boxes Drupal has warned of a new highly critical vulnerability in Drupal Core that attackers are actively exploiting to take over vulnerable websites. Tracked as CVE-2026-136716, the flaw is related to improper handling of unusual or incomplete installation states. It is connected to CVE-2026-132165 , also known as Fail2Install, which Drupal patched on November 18. However, the previous fix did not address every vulnerable installation scenario. “ SA-CORE-2026-017 recently fixed several vulnerabilities within the Drupal core installer. However, certain sites in unusual or incomplete install states remain vulnerable to site takeover following that advisory, including production sites. ” Drupal maintainers warned .
